title: Care falls due
about: What keeps a WormBed5 working comes round by a rhythm (every day, week, month) or by the season, and some of it is brought forward when something happens. The care calendar comes from PermTek-5; this edge keeps the record. Here a week passes, you do your part, the robot does its part by a job you confirm, and a storm brings a check of the frame forward.

steps.title: A week goes by
steps.why: The clock runs at five hours a second. On day one the guild counts as settled: nothing is due. After a week the weekly tasks are: filling the hopper and looking at the box are yours, looking the bed over for weeds is the robot's.

do.label: Run the clock: 5 hours a second

steps.title: You: fill the hopper, and say so
steps.why: The clock goes back to normal. You fill the hopper and press Done on the task: the record keeps the date, and the task comes round again in a week.

steps.title: Robot: look the bed over for weeds
steps.why: The robot's tasks are done by its jobs. When the look over the bed finishes, the weekly weed task counts as done; nobody has to tick it.

steps.title: A storm
steps.why: Storm wind locks the gantry out. It also brings a task forward: after a storm, look at the frame, the roof drain and the waterproofing.

steps.title: You: check the frame once the storm has passed
steps.why: The wind drops; you look the frame over and press Done.
